purpose: Single-run diagnostic A/B for the eligible historical-pass regression at Order 118. Replace an ambiguous composition of terminal launch, stdout capture, GUI focus, and screenshot commands with one reusable terminal-command screenshot facade. This prior-outcome-selected run is not a baseline denominator.
hypothesis: The v210 run successfully executed the requested command and produced a valid PNG, but the generic terminal launcher displayed only command output and an exit marker, not the model-selected command itself. The saved image therefore lacked a reliable visible command label. The eligible v124 historical pass was also unstable: it passed only because an incidental intermediate filename containing the command token appeared in the directory listing, while the Agent used 15 steps, six errors, and never terminated normally. If an explicit terminal.capture_command_screenshot action displays the exact shell-escaped model argv before the completed output and exit status, captures that terminal window, and verifies a PNG at the model-selected path, Qwen can satisfy the workflow directly without stdout/image confusion or GUI focus loops.
change_scope: A focused OS terminal_capture module launches one finite model-selected argv in a visible GNOME Terminal, displays the exact shell-escaped argv, waits for a command-completion marker, focuses the uniquely titled window, saves a PNG with gnome-screenshot, validates its PNG header and dimensions, checks the model-selected expected return codes, and records shell history only when the model selected that provenance. A focused LiteAgent terminal_capture_semantics module recognizes only explicit command-execution plus terminal-window screenshot plus saved-PNG requests and recommends the public facade without deriving arguments. The model must select argv, cwd_source, optional cwd_path, output_path, optional expected_returncodes, provenance, and overwrite unchanged. Multi-Apps forwards those arguments verbatim to the OS Adapter. No command, directory, filename, task identity, answer, coordinate, or evaluator value is selected or injected by the Runner.

sources.v210_outcome: Strict evidence-valid failure: reward 0.0, generic_api_plus_gui, 22 steps, seven structured errors, five tool searches, five repeated-action blocks, and stalled_no_progress. Qwen ran the requested command, launched a visible terminal, produced a valid PNG through gnome-screenshot, and then looped among command.capture_output, GUI focus clicks, and search. The preserved evaluator image showed the directory listing and exit marker but not the executed command text.
sources.historical_clean_pass_outcome: Reward 1.0 and current strict re-audit valid, evidence-valid, and baseline-admissible with zero task/golden leakage and zero model/Runner argument mismatches. The Agent used 15 steps, six errors, and did not terminate normally. Its screenshot passed because an incidental intermediate output filename containing the command token appeared in the listing, not because the terminal contract displayed argv.

implementation_evidence.counterfactuals: Positive routing covers df -h, uname -a, and a quoted build command with different PNG names and structures. Negative routing rejects saved stdout text, VLC frame capture, insertion of an existing terminal image into Writer, a desktop screenshot, and launching a GUI application from a terminal. A structurally different /srv/data workflow proves the strict surface exposes only terminal.capture_command_screenshot, the model-selected argv, working directory, output path, return codes, provenance, and overwrite reach the executor unchanged, and completion requires a real verified call. OS tests use df -h /var/lib, a different working directory, a different output name and dimensions, and verify that the exact argv is both executed and visibly rendered. Schema tests reject missing output paths, non-PNG paths, invalid cwd combinations, boolean return codes, inferred provenance, extra task_id, and unsupported parameters.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 699 passed across terminal screenshot semantics, OS implementation and schema, OS health, Multi-Apps schema and forwarding, catalog behavior, strict schema-manifest validation, and runtime module ownership
implementation_evidence.ruff: passed for all changed active source, scripts, tests, and Adapters

selection.method: same fixed eligible regression item, first evidence-backed reusable hypothesis after comparing the preserved v210 actual requests and screenshots with the current strict re-audit of the historical clean pass
